## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** the audio types (`AudioStreamBasicDescription`, …) in isim's `_AudioToolboxTypes` module and `isim/sdk-src/usr/include/CoreAudioTypes`. Rows: [AudioToolbox](AudioToolbox.md).
